Number of pyramid levels

Source: R/class-image.R
at_n_levels.Rd

Number of pyramid levels

Usage

at_n_levels(x, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

x

An annot_image.

call

The calling environment, for error reporting.

Value

An integer scalar; 1 when the image has no pyramid.

See also
